LanguageData.CC_Social_VendettaSettled_captive: {0} has settled with {1} for {2}, partly with captives.
LanguageData.CC_Social_VendettaSettled_home: {2} came home, and {0} let the matter of {1} rest.
LanguageData.CC_Social_VendettaSettled_forgiven: {0} laid down the vendetta against {1} for {2}.
LanguageData.CC_Social_VendettaSettled_peace: {0} made peace with {1} over {2}, once the colony had.
LanguageData.CC_Cause_Peacemaker: {0}, the peacemaker, sat them down together
LanguageData.CC_Cause_KeeperOfDays: {0}, the keeper of days, saw it kept properly
LanguageData.CC_Ways_TraitPride: Colonists with a passion for {0} are proud of it.
LanguageData.CC_Ways_TraitFading: People have stopped calling the colony {0}.
LanguageData.CC_Ways_TraitsHeader: What the work has made us
LanguageData.CC_Ways_TraitsIntro: Beside the five ways, a colony grows into what its people keep doing. Steady work for a season earns the name; it fades if the work stops.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Fresh_Detail: No fruit or vegetables in a week or more: {0}. Weeks of that bring scurvy. Raw vegetables, berries or meals cooked with them all count.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Lonely_Detail: Nobody here they would call a friend: {0}. Shared work, shared meals and a gathering now and then are the usual cure.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_CampTense_Detail: Feeling at the camp ({0}) is {1}. A gift, keeping to the terms or a word with their leader can ease it before it boils over.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_CampHungry_Detail: Food is running out at the camp ({0}). A hungry camp hunts harder on the colony's land, and packs up and leaves if it runs out.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_CalSoon_Detail: {0} comes round soon, kept as {1}. Plan the day around it, or let it pass from the Calendar page.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_CalSoon_Tradition: It's a tradition now: letting it pass will disappoint everyone.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Graves_Detail: Some of the colony's dead lie in graves left dirty or outside the home area, where nobody cleans. Tidy them, or bring the graveyard into the home area.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Clothes_Title: {0} colonist(s) in rags or dead men's clothes
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Clothes_Tainted: Wearing clothes taken from the dead: {0}.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_JoyTime_Title: {0} colonist(s) with no time for recreation
LanguageData.CC_Adv_JoyTime_Detail: Not one hour of recreation in the schedule: {0}. Give them an hour or two in the evening, or some "anything" hours.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Strain_Detail: Close to breaking under the surface: {0}. Rest, recreation, a gathering or a quiet day will bring it down.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Conval_Detail: Still weak and working anyway: {0}. Rest in bed would get them well about a third sooner.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_WishLapse_Detail: These run out within the day, and nothing has been promised. Grant them or make a promise from the Wishes page; a wish left to lapse costs trust.
LanguageData.CC_ScenPart_Bond_spouses: Rimfolk: two of the colonists are married (or close friends, if they couldn't be).
LanguageData.CC_Scen_Bond_spouses: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} are married, and everything they own is in this place now.
LanguageData.CC_Scen_Hint_Troupe: Word of a company of players settling down travels fast among wandering folk. Someone will come looking for an audience before long.
LanguageData.CC_Scen_Hint_Monastery: The old house sent word ahead that the new one keeps open doors. Pilgrims and wandering holy folk will find their way here soon.
LanguageData.CC_Scen_Hint_Family: The family back home was promised news within the month. They'll come to see for themselves, or at least write.
